description: Header file defining the SecondaryCommandBuffer class and related Vulkan command structures for ANGLE's Vulkan renderer. It manages CPU-side command buffers for GPU submission, including command definitions, serialization, and execution support.

classes.name: rx::vk::priv::SecondaryCommandBuffer
classes.description: A class representing a CPU-side command buffer for Vulkan, capable of recording various Vulkan commands and executing them on a primary command buffer.

methods.name: beginQuery
methods.description: Starts a Vulkan query in the command buffer.

methods.name: bindComputePipeline
methods.description: Binds a compute pipeline for subsequent commands.

methods.name: bindDescriptorSets
methods.description: Binds descriptor sets to the pipeline.

methods.name: blitImage
methods.description: Records a command to blit an image.

methods.name: clearColorImage
methods.description: Records a command to clear a color image.

methods.name: clearDepthStencilImage
methods.description: Records a command to clear a depth/stencil image.

methods.name: copyBufferToImage
methods.description: Records a command to copy buffer to image.

methods.name: copyImageToBuffer
methods.description: Records a command to copy image to buffer.

methods.name: drawIndexedBaseVertex
methods.description: Records an indexed draw with base vertex.

methods.name: drawIndexedInstancedBaseVertex
methods.description: Records an instanced indexed draw with base vertex.

methods.name: drawIndexedInstancedBaseVertexBaseInstance
methods.description: Records an indexed draw with multiple base parameters.

methods.name: drawInstancedBaseInstance
methods.description: Records an instanced draw with base instance.

methods.name: fillBuffer
methods.description: Fills a buffer with a value.

methods.name: pipelineBarrier
methods.description: Records a pipeline barrier with multiple barriers.

methods.name: resetQueryPool
methods.description: Resets a range of queries in a query pool.

methods.name: executeCommands
methods.description: Executes the recorded commands into a primary command buffer.

methods.name: dumpCommands
methods.description: Returns a string summary of recorded commands for diagnostics.
